entities.summary: Olga Holtz is a Russian mathematician specializing in numerical analysis. She received the Sofia Kovalevskaya Award in 2006 and the European Mathematical Society Prize (2008). Since 2008, she is a member of the Young Academy of Germany. Olga Holtz was a logicians & mathematicians from Chelyabinsk (b. 1973-08-19, Chelyabinsk). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
